cuts.placeText: a candy workshop — a marble worktable, copper sugar pots, jars of rainbow candies and a pulling hook on the wall
cuts.scene: she is the master candy maker sitting sideways on a chair, drawing out a long glossy rope of candy with both hands at the marble table
